verses.text: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
The beast I saw looked like a leopard, but its feet were like a bear’s and its mouth like a lion’s. The dragon gave the beast his power, throne, and great authority.
One of the beast’s heads looked as if it had been fatally wounded, but the fatal wound had healed. The whole world was amazed and followed the beast.
People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?”
The beast was given a mouth to boast and blaspheme, and it was allowed to exercise authority for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to blaspheme God and slander his name, his dwelling place, and those who live in heaven.
It was allowed to wage war against God’s holy people and conquer them. It was given authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
All the people living on earth will worship the beast—everyone whose name hasn’t been written in the book of life belonging to the Lamb who was slaughtered from the creation of the world.

“If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity they’ll go. If anyone is to be killed by the sword, by the sword they’ll be killed.” Here’s the call for God’s holy people to endure and remain faithful.
Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf and made the earth and its people worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had healed.
It performed great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in full view of people.

Because of the signs it was allowed to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the people living on earth. It told them to make an image of the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet lived.
It was allowed to give breath to the image of the first beast, so the image could speak and cause everyone who refused to worship it to be killed.
It forced everyone—small and great, rich and poor, free and slave—to receive a mark on their right hands or foreheads,
so that no one could buy or sell unless they had the mark: the beast’s name or the number of its name.
This calls for wisdom. Let the one with insight calculate the number of the beast, because it’s the number of a person. Its number is 666.
